title: Acne (Pitta)
summary: Cool and cleanse gently for clear skin
ayurvedicView: Acne is often a Pitta condition showing heat and inflammation. Cooling herbs and gentle care help restore skin balance.
remedies: Neem + turmeric paste, rinse after 10-15 minutes
Apply thin layer of pure aloe vera gel
Reduce intake of fried and spicy foods
Drink plenty of water throughout the day
Manjistha powder with rose water as a face pack (test on a small patch first)
tips: Keep skin clean but don't over-wash
seeDoctor: Painful, deep lumps (cysts) or acne that leaves scars
Acne that does not improve after two to three months of care
Sudden severe acne in adulthood, or with irregular periods or extra hair growth
